name: Sons of the Duellist
lore: The Primal Duellist is perhaps the second-greatest swordsman to ever exist, after only the Shattered King himself. His clashes with enemies have become tales of legend, holding off larger and stronger foes through sheer wit and skill. His Legion likewise excels at handling the worst enemies to be found in the realms, using superior weapons, specialized equipment, and cunning tactics to achieve victory.

rules.name: Resilience of the Duellist
rules.lore: The Primal Duellist and his sons are known for their unshakable resolve, maintaining the strictest of discipline in battle even while enduring the harshest of conditions and the unrelenting assaults of the enemy. Indeed, enemy attacks seem only to strengthen them.
rules.text: While a +Shattered Legions+ unit in your army is battleshocked, its Objective Control is 1, instead of 0.

strategems.name: Blade Answer
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, melee weapons equipped by models in the target unit have +[Lethal Hits]+. If the target unit is Battle-Shocked, those weapons also have +1 to their =swords= Attacks trait.

strategems.name: Unbroken Guard
strategems.when: After an Activated enemy unit declares an attack
strategems.effect: Until the end of that attack sequence, models in the target unit have an =shield-plus= Invulnerable Save of 5+. If the target unit is Battle-Shocked, that save is 4+ instead.

strategems.name: Riposte Volley
strategems.when: After an Activated enemy unit has completed its Shoot attacks
strategems.target: A +Shattered Legions+ unit that just had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of those attacks
strategems.effect: The target unit can shoot as if it was Activated, but it must target the enemy unit that is currently Activated, and only if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

spells.name: Mind Worm
spells.effect: Select one enemy unit within 18". It suffers 1 Mortal Damage and must take a Battle-Shock test.

spells.name: Righteous Motivation
spells.effect: Select one friendly +Legion of the Duellist+ unit within 12". Until the end of the Battle Round, models in that unit can re-roll Hit rolls and Wound rolls for melee attacks.

spells.name: Deepening Fear
spells.effect: Select one enemy unit within 24". Until the end of the Battle Round, that unit has its =flag= Leadership worsened by 1, has an =arrows-to-circle= Objective Control trait of 0, and cannot use +Secure Objectives+.

upgrades.name: Scion of the Duellist
upgrades.text: At the start of the battle, gain 1 CP.

upgrades.name: Silent Command
upgrades.text: Your +Warlord+ has !Feel No Pain 5+! while it is Battle-Shocked.

upgrades.name: Grim Execution
upgrades.text: Your +Shattered Legions+ +Infantry+ units have +1" to their =person-running= Movement traits while they are Battle-Shocked.
